statement: The entire coherent complex3-unit norm group in the seventeen tower has finite-index torsion-free stable projections of exact ranks3^d and actual surjective transitions with kernel ranks2*3^d. Literal recursive integral splittings give Z3 times the unrestricted product of these kernels. The whole family embeds into actual global H sections with pure component1; its base image is lambda^(3^h Z3) for a finite h>=1, and every nonempty toric fiber, including(kappa17,0), is the displayed full product. The finite indices are retained as unevaluated data.
depends_on: E.46 exact norm-system/section homeomorphism and scaled toric map
Kato Theorem1.1(2), Corollary5.2(2) with coherent universal-norm definition
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d), actual norm-coherent section families and toric fibers
notes: Kato defines his source as the image of an actual norm-compatible inverse limit over all finite intermediate fields. The explicit restriction map to the L_d chain and downward norms proves finite index of every stable projection.

Local norm depth2 at17 is the ninth power on the fixed residue field F289. Its three-primary part is killed, and reduction is injective on the global mu3 torsion. This proves each I_d is torsion-free.

The actual maps N:I_(d+1)->I_d are surjective by the definition of projection from the compatible limit; their finite free kernels have exact rank2*3^d. Chosen integral basis lifts give the literal product recursion and its inverse.

E57 gives the complete first3-unit norm image lambda^Z3. The residue lambda^32=zeta forces exponent divisible by3, so I0=lambda^(3^h Z3) for one finite h>=1. Its numerical value remains explicitly unevaluated.

All coherent complex3-unit tuples with pure component1 satisfy the actual total-norm cube condition; their scaled toric coordinate is3^(h-1)z*kappa3(3). The complete zero-toric subfamily is the compact product of the exact kernel modules.
The embedding into multiplicative completions is proved by the induced power filtration and the torsion-free divisor quotient. E46 supplies the exact topological Kummer-Shapiro section map.

Compactness is used only for the finitely generated unit completions. It proves projection equals intersection of finite norm images; finite index then proves eventual stabilization, without claiming a stopping bound or that the first equal consecutive images suffice.
The finite program checks every one of288 residue units, the order32 ninth-power image, its trivial intersection with mu3, and27 lambda exponents. It does not calculate h.

The second finite projection is exactly N_{L2/K}U2=lambda^(3Z3), with explicit preimage c1=beta1+3zeta+1 included into L2. Its index in U0 is9. The finite exponents a_n satisfy a1=0,a2=1 and a_n<=a_(n+1)<=a_n+1, eventually equal to h; h itself is not set to1.
